text: dsh-chime（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH 的会话和代理事件播放本地提示音。它通过 Host 插件监听提问、工具审批、登录提示、回答结束或报错，以及子代理、后台作业、目标和会话收尾事件，并在浏览器插件面板提供设置表单。主要功能包括按事件播放不同声音、调节音量和重复间隔、逐项启停提示、替换 WAV 音色及查看调试日志。适合希望通过声音留意 DSH 进展的用户。运行需要 Windows 系统自带的 PowerShell；没有 API Key 或外部服务配置。
想让 DSH 在回答结束或出错时响一声。
有没有办法用声音提醒我工具审批和代理提问？
I want an audible cue when a DSH turn finishes or fails.
dsh-chime 的功能「事件声音提醒」：监听 DSH 的提问、审批、登录提示、轮次结束或报错，以及子代理、后台作业、目标和会话事件，并播放相应的内置提示音；可在设置中关闭单项或更换 WAV。

dsh-chime (DSH Web plugin): plays cues for questions, approvals, turn completion or errors, jobs, goals, and sessions. Its panel controls volume, repeat gaps, event switches, custom WAVs, and debug logging. Playback uses Windows PowerShell; no API key or external service.

dsh-chime README · dsh-chime：DSH 的提示音插件。Agent 提问、等你审批、一轮说完、出错，以及子代理、后台作业、目标、会话收尾时，响一声。

只出声，不弹窗，不抢焦点。仅 Windows。

dsh-chime README · 安装：把下面这句直接发给你的 DSH Agent：

> 帮我装这个插件：plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=https://github.com/GemsCat/dsh-chime

装完左侧边栏「插件」面板里就有 `dsh-chime`，点开它的行就能调设置。

不想用 git 的话，下载 [Release](https://github.com/GemsCat/dsh-chime/releases/latest) 里的 tgz，同样交给 Agent：

> 帮我装这个插件：plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=把 tgz 的完整路径粘在这里

dsh-chime README · 什么时候响：| 场景 | 声音 |
|---|---|
| Agent 向你提问、等你审批、要你重新登录 | `alert` |
| 一轮说完，轮到你了 | `done` |
| 子代理交回结果、后台作业结束、目标完成 | `done` |
| 这一轮报错，或回答超出长度 | `error` |
| 目标被阻塞、会话停止、被外部中断 | `stopped` |

同一种声音 600 毫秒内不重复；子代理不会再多响一次；你自己按下的停止不响。

dsh-chime README · 调整：插件面板 → `dsh-chime` → 表单里改：总开关、音量、最小间隔、逐项开关、自定义音色、调试日志。
改完立即生效，重装或升级插件都不会丢。

想换音色：填 PCM WAV 的绝对路径（44.1kHz / 16bit / 单声道最稳），留空就用内置音。

dsh-chime README · 不响的时候：打开「写调试日志」，然后看 `%TEMP%\dsh-chime.log`。一次响动一行，能看出是没触发、
被最小间隔挡了、还是音色文件找不到。

dsh-chime README · 顺带说明：- 播放用的是系统自带的 PowerShell，不装任何依赖，不常驻内存，不占端口。
- 不区分窗口是否聚焦：你正盯着屏幕时也会响。嫌吵就关掉对应项。
- 定时任务投递、断线重连、上下文压缩这三种情况目前不响——DSH 没有可靠的信号。
- 插件装在 DSH 的 profile 里，DSH 版本升级不会把它清掉。
dsh-chime README · 许可：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

dsh-chime README · dsh-chime：Sound cues for DSH. A short chime when the agent asks you something, waits for approval, finishes a
turn, or errors — and when a subagent, background job, goal, or session settles.

Sound only: no popups, no focus stealing. Windows only.

dsh-chime README · Install：Send this line to your DSH agent:

> Install this plugin for me: plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=https://github.com/GemsCat/dsh-chime

Once it finishes, `dsh-chime` appears in the **Plugins** panel on the left; expand its row to adjust settings.

Prefer not to use git? Download the tgz from [Releases](https://github.com/GemsCat/dsh-chime/releases/latest)
and hand it to the agent the same way:

> Install this plugin for me: plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=path-to-the-tgz

dsh-chime README · When it chimes：| Moment | Sound |
|---|---|
| The agent asks you a question, waits for approval, or needs a sign-in | `alert` |
| A turn finished and it is your turn again | `done` |
| A subagent reports back, a background job ends, a goal completes | `done` |
| The turn errored or hit the length limit | `error` |
| A goal got blocked, a session stopped, a turn was interrupted | `stopped` |

The same sound never repeats within 600 ms; a subagent does not ring twice; your own stop press stays silent.

dsh-chime README · Settings：Plugins panel → `dsh-chime` → the form: master switch, volume, minimum gap, per-event switches,
custom sounds, debug log. Changes apply immediately and survive reinstalls and upgrades.

To swap a sound, give an absolute path to a PCM WAV (44.1 kHz / 16-bit / mono is safest); leave it empty for the built-in.

dsh-chime README · When nothing rings：Turn on the debug log and read `%TEMP%\dsh-chime.log` — one line per cue, enough to tell whether the
event never fired, the minimum gap swallowed it, or the sound file was missing.

dsh-chime README · Notes：- Playback uses the built-in PowerShell: no dependencies, nothing resident, no open port.
- No focus filtering: it chimes while you are watching the screen. Turn off the cue you find noisy.
- Scheduled-task delivery, reconnects, and context compaction stay silent — DSH exposes no reliable signal for them.
- The plugin lives in the DSH profile, so a DSH version update does not remove it.
